ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Certipy Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Certipy execution, a tool for Active Directory Certificate Services enumeration and abuse based on PE metadata characteristics and common command line arguments.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Certipy\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Certipy\.exe" OR process_description = RGX(".*Certipy.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ account\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ auth\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cert\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ find\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ forge\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ptt\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ relay\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ req\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ shadow\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ template\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-bloodhound.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ca\\-pfx\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-dc\\-ip\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-kirbi.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-old\\-bloodhound.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-pfx\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-target.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-template.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-username\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-vulnerable.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*auth\\ \\-pfx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*shadow\\ auto.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*shadow\\ list.*")))
